name: 11776 · Port Jeff Sta, NY
findings: ZIP 11776 (Port Jeff Sta) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11776 (Port Jeff Sta) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11776 (Port Jeff Sta) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 53% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
